info.title: Invoice4U API
info.description:
The Invoice4U API lets you create tax-compliant documents (invoices, receipts, credit invoices and more), manage customers and branches, and charge credit cards through the Invoice4U clearing service.

Unless marked GET (query-string parameters), endpoints are POST with a JSON body that wraps the operation parameters by name (WCF wrapped-request style). Responses wrap the result in a single `d` property: `{ "d": ... }`. Dates use the WCF format `"/Date(1788210000000+0300)/"` (milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC plus offset); ISO strings are not accepted. Almost every endpoint takes your organization API key as `token`.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Create and retrieve documents (invoices, receipts, etc.).

tags.name: Catalog Items
tags.description: Read the organization's item catalog. Available to all accounts; does not require the Inventory module.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Manage inventory items, categories, suppliers, warehouses, and pricing.

tags.name: Clearing
tags.description: Credit-card charges, tokens, standing orders and clearing logs.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Account-level reference data: VAT rate and document numbering.

post.summary: Verify a token or API key
post.description: Validates an organization API key (GUID) or token and returns the resolved user. An account expired more than 4 days ago adds an `ExpiredAccount` error.

200.description: Resolved user, or a user object whose Errors array is populated when the token/key is invalid or the account is expired.

post.description: Creates a customer in the authenticated organization. If `cu.ID` exists, behaves like an update. Negative returned ID = conflict: -1 name, -2 external number, -3 unique ID, -4 GUID.

Updates an existing customer. `cu.ID` must be a valid existing customer ID. `PayTerms`, `Active` and `Retainer` are non-nullable, so the API always writes back whatever value you send for them — omit one and it resets to its default.

Filtered search. Only `UniqueID`, `Name`, `ExtNumber`, `Active`, `Retainer`, `HasBeenExported`, `Email`, `Phone`, `Cell` and `FreeUniqueID` are honored as filters; any other populated field is ignored. `Active` is non-nullable and is always sent, so omitting it searches for inactive customers — send `Active: true` to find active ones.
Returns all branches for the authenticated organization. Returns null on auth/server error.

Returns the item catalog of the authenticated organization. Available to all accounts, with or without the Inventory module. Read-only: the API has no endpoint for creating or updating catalog items. Returns null on auth/server error.

GetAll.description: false returns active items only; true returns all items, including inactive ones.

post.summary: Get a catalog item by code
post.description: Returns a single catalog item by exact code. Available to all accounts, with or without the Inventory module. Only ID, UserId, Code, Name, Price, PriceAfterTax and VatPercentage are populated. Returns null when not found or on auth/server error.
Records a receipt document for items received into inventory.
Creates a signed, numbered document. Totals are computed server-side from Items/Payments. Check the returned Errors list before using the result.

200.description: The created document (or a document carrying Errors).

post.summary: Create a document with idempotency by ApiIdentifier
post.description: Same as CreateDocument, but if a document with the same ApiIdentifier and type already exists, the existing document is returned with error DocumentAlreadyCreated (134) instead of creating a duplicate.

post.summary: Get document by number and type
post.description: Document numbers are sequential per type, so documentType is required.
Recommended recovery path after a timed-out create call.

Searches documents of a single type per call — `DocumentType` is required. `CustomerName` only verifies that a customer with that name exists; it is not applied as a search filter for new-system results — use `CustomerID` to filter by customer. Ignored by this endpoint: `DocumentTypes`, `FromPaymentDueDate`/`ToPaymentDueDate`, `FromNumber`/`ToNumber`, `ItemDescription`, `ItemsIncluded`, `PaymentsIncluded` — these fields exist on the shared `DocumentsRequest` schema for other consumers.

post.summary: Create or update a draft document
post.description: Saves an editable draft: no legal number, no quota usage, relaxed validation. Sending an existing draft ID updates it. IsPreviewDocument targets the organization's single preview slot.

post.summary: Get a draft document by GUID
Check whether a draft exists for a document type

200.description: True/false; null when the token is invalid.
Result envelope; DraftDocumentDeleteError (135) per failed id.
The preview document (saved with IsPreviewDocument: true).

post.summary: Fetch an Israel Tax allocation number for a document

200.description: Success returns `d: null` — the document is not returned. Only a failure (invalid token, or allocationNumber shorter than 9 characters, AllocationNumberInvalid=162) returns a Document with Errors.

post.description: Creates a hosted payment page, charges a saved token, or refunds a previous charge — and optionally creates the matching document. The response is the same object enriched with results (ClearingRedirectUrl, PaymentId, DocumentNumber...).

refund.summary: Refund a previous charge by PaymentId
refund.description: Server-to-server, no redirect. PaymentId locates the original charge in the clearing log (PaymentIDDoesntExists 60 when not found). On success, an InvoiceCredit is created automatically when the original document is traceable via the clearing log.

searchParams.description: Filter object; every field is optional and ignored when omitted.

ClearingLogId.description: Filter to a single log by ID. Only applied when greater than 0.

OrganizationId.description: Ignored — the API always scopes results to your token's organization.

CreditCardNumber.description: Card number/last digits as stored on the log.

CreditCardType.description: Your organization's credit-card company ID (matches the returned CreditType/CreditTypeName).

IsCredit.description: true to return only refund/credit rows.

CompanyType.description: ClearingCompanies enum: 6 UPay, 7 Meshulam, 12 YaadSarig (historical records only), 15 Cardcom.

TransactionType.description: 0 Charge, 1 TokenCreation, 2 TokenAndCharge, 3 ChargeByToken, 4 PaymentInNumbers, 5 PaymentWithFees, 6 Credit, 7 MobileAppPersonalPayment, 8 TokenPaymentInNumbers.

post.summary: Register a new Invoice4U account (partners only)
post.description: Restricted endpoint: requires a valid `token` (checked the same way as IsAuthenticated) and a partner-specific `uniqueToken` issued by Invoice4U. The calling server IP must also be whitelisted, though some partner integrations are exempt. Contact Invoice4U business development for onboarding.

200.description: The registered account; check Errors. An invalid/missing token or uniqueToken both return UnauthorizedUser (80); ApiUnauthorizedAccessInvalidIPAddress=306 for a non-whitelisted IP.

post.description: Stock movement rows (date, quantity, entry, exit, opening) for one inventory item — or all items when itemId is omitted — within an optional date range. Requires an active Inventory module.

itemId.description: Inventory item ID. Omit or null for all items.

200.description: ItemsMovement. {"d":null} on a fully invalid/missing token. On an expired account: an ItemsMovement object with Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] and Item/ItemsBalance both null. On an inactive Inventory module: same shape with Errors [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)].

post.description: Movement totals per inventory item (entry, exit, opening, balance, price) within an optional date range. Requires an active Inventory module.

200.description: Array of ItemBalance. Empty array ({"d":[]}) on an invalid/missing token. One-element array carrying Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)] when the Inventory module is inactive.

post.description: Emails an existing document to the customer's email — or to the addresses in AssociatedEmails. Sends a real email.

ID.description: Document ID (GUID) returned by CreateDocument. The server reloads the document from the database by this ID — every other doc field you send is ignored.

AssociatedEmails.description: Recipients. Omit to send to the customer's email.

200.description: Info [SuccessfulAction (2)] on success. Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or when the document belongs to another organization; Errors [GeneralError (0)] on an invalid/undecodable token or any other failure while sending the email.

post.description: Returns the system-wide standard Israeli VAT rate for today, or for the given date — the same value for every organization, not each organization's own VAT setting.

date.description: Optional date as yyyy-MM-dd (e.g. 2024-12-31), parsed with DateTime.TryParse. Omit it to get the current system-wide standard rate (from the TaxRate app setting, same for every organization) regardless of today's date. An unparseable value causes an HTTP 500 fault (uncaught ArgumentException).

200.description: Tax. TaxRate is 17 for dates before 2025-01-01, otherwise the system-wide standard rate from the TaxRate app setting (same value for every organization, not the organization's own VAT setting). Invalid token or expired account: TaxRate -1 with Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] (the ExpiredAccount (66) error from IsAuthenticated is not carried over).

post.description: Returns the organization's document numbering definition: starting number per document type, whether each type already has documents, accounting ledger numbers, and bank details.

200.description: NumberingDefinition object with only Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] populated (every other field is its CLR default 0/false/null) on an invalid token or an expired account — the ExpiredAccount (66) error from IsAuthenticated is not carried over. {"d":null} on an unexpected server/database error.

get.summary: Check whether a document exists by ApiIdentifier
get.description: GET with query-string parameters. true when a document with this ApiIdentifier exists in your organization. Also returns false when the token is invalid or expired — verify the token first with IsAuthenticated.

parameters.name: apiIdentifier
parameters.description: The ApiIdentifier you sent when creating the document.

post.summary: Get a customer by GUID (with inner search)
post.description: Like GetCustomerByGuid, with the lookup's inner search enabled (AlsoInnerSearch). Returns null when not found and when the token is invalid or expired — the two cases are indistinguishable.

post.summary: Get a customer by client code (alias)
post.description: Alias of GetCustomerByClientCode — same lookup and response. Returns null when not found. An invalid or expired token raises an unhandled server error (HTTP 500) rather than a normal error response.

The documents of one customer in a date range. Only From, To, CustomerID, Status and DocumentType are used; other DocumentsRequest fields are ignored. An invalid token returns an empty envelope (no Response, no Errors).

DocumentType.description: Document type filter; omit or 0 = all types.

200.description: Documents in Response. Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account. An invalid/undecodable token returns an empty envelope — neither Response nor Errors populated; treat that the same as a failure.

post.description: Whether the organization is connected to Israel Invoices (allocation numbers), and since when.

200.description: IsraelInvoicesStatus. Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] when the token is invalid.

post.description: Partner-only (User Registration API). Replaces the organization's API key with the GUID you supply. The old key stops working immediately.

token.description: Current API key of the organization whose key is replaced.

200.description: User object — only Errors and Info are meaningful. Success: Info [{ ID: 0, Info: "success" }]. Errors: UnauthorizedUser (80) when the token itself is invalid; ExpiredAccount (66) when the token is valid but the account expired more than 4 days ago (the key is left unchanged) — note this is NOT UnauthorizedUser (80); ApiKeyNotInCorrectFormat (303) when newAkU isn't a valid GUID; ApiKeyWasntGenerated (144) when the new key couldn't be saved; GeneralError (0) on an unexpected server error.

post.summary: Get a customer with full details
post.description: Returns the full customer record, including bank details, contacts and additional emails.

200.description: Customer. Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] when the token is invalid.

name.description: Customer name, passed to the lookup together with email.

post.summary: Get a customer by client code

200.description: Customer, or null when not found. An invalid or expired token is not caught by a try block, so it raises an unhandled server error (HTTP 500) instead of a normal error response.
Customer, or null when not found.

post.summary: Get a customer by external number

number.description: The customer's external number. 0 or negative returns CustomerNotFound (136).

post.description: Creates a new price list in the authenticated organization. IsActive is a required (non-nullable) field on the wire, so omitting it deserializes as false and the price list is created inactive with no warning. OrganizationID is ignored if sent — the server always overwrites it with the authenticated organization.

200.description: The created price list. null on an invalid/missing token; a Pricelist object carrying Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)] when the Inventory module is inactive.

post.description: Retrieves all price lists for the authenticated organization.

isActive.description: true = active only, false = inactive only, omit/null = all.

200.description: Price lists. null on an invalid/missing token; a one-element array carrying Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)] when the Inventory module is inactive.

Price lists. null on an invalid/missing token; a one-element array carrying Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)] when the Inventory module is inactive.

post.description: Retrieves price lists for multiple customers at once.

200.description: Price lists with their CustomerId. null on an invalid/missing token; a one-element array carrying Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)] when the Inventory module is inactive.

post.description: Updates an existing price list; pricelist must include Id. OrganizationID is ignored if sent — the server always overwrites it with the authenticated organization.

customerID.description: Optional customer to link; used only when > 0.

200.description: The updated price list. null on an invalid/missing token; a Pricelist object carrying Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)] when the Inventory module is inactive.

post.description: Removes customers from price list assignments.

200.description: true on success. This endpoint never returns an error object — it also returns false on an invalid/missing token, an expired account, an inactive Inventory module, or any server error; the cases are indistinguishable from the response alone.

post.description: Retrieves the inventory cost report for a specific date, showing all items and their valuations.

200.description: Cost per item (InventoryId, ItemName, ItemCode, UnitType, Cost, Price, TotalPrice, Qty). Empty array ({"d":[]}) on an invalid/missing token (this method's backing list is initialized to an empty List<ItemBalance> instead of null); a one-element array carrying Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)] when the Inventory module is inactive.

filterType.description: Period: 0 all time, 1 this month, 2 last month, 3 the past week (EInventoryReportFilterTypes.LastWeek). There is no quarter/year option.

200.description: Items with Id, Name and QuantityToNotify (holds the quantity sold when type is 0, the sales value when type is 1 — no other item fields are populated). null on an invalid/missing token; a one-element array carrying Errors [UnauthorizedUser (80)] on an expired account, or [UnauthorizedInventoryAttempt (403)] when the Inventory module is inactive.

Items with Name and QuantityToNotify (= total inventory value; no Id, Code, Quantity, Cost or TotalValue field). null in all three cases — invalid/missing token, expired account, or inactive Inventory module — a null-reference bug means no error object is ever returned.

get.summary: Record an external charge in the clearing log
get.description: GET with query-string parameters. clearingLog is a URL-encoded JSON ClearingLog object.

ID.description: Numeric error code, e.g. 80 = UnauthorizedUser, 134 = DocumentAlreadyCreated.

CommonObject.description: Response envelope inherited by most objects. Server-generated — never send these fields in requests. Always check Errors before using the payload.

IsUserMail.description: true marks the copy sent to the account owner.

GenerelCustomer.description: One-off (general) customer for documents without a stored customer record.

PriceIncludeTax.description: Ignored by document creation — with TaxIncluded=true, Price itself is treated as the gross (tax-included) price and the server reverse-calculates the net amount. Read only by draft calculation (CreateOrUpdateDraftDocument with IsCalcBeforeTax).

ID.description: Existing payment ID — used for Deposits documents.

PaymentType.description: 1 CreditCard, 2 Check, 3 MoneyTransfer, 4 Cash, 5 Credit, 6 WithholdingTax, 7 Other, 8 Bit, 9 PayBox.

Date.description: Payment date. Required unless DateStr is supplied instead.

DateStr.description: Fallback payment date, read only when Date is null, parsed strictly as dd/MM/yyyy — any other format (or both fields missing) fails with PaymentDateMissing (46).

CreditCardName.description: Card brand name; resolved against configured credit companies.

DocumentType.description: 1 Invoice, 2 Receipt, 3 InvoiceReceipt, 4 InvoiceCredit, 5 ProformaInvoice, 6 InvoiceOrder, 7 InvoiceQuote, 8 InvoiceShip, 9 Deposits, 10 SupplierInvoiceToInventory, 13 PurchaseOrder.

ClientID.description: Existing customer ID. Required unless GeneralCustomer is supplied or the type doesn't need a customer.

Invoices.description: Referenced documents (each with ID and ReceiptAmount). Requires DocumentReffType.

IssueDate.description: Defaults to today. Not in the future; not before your latest document of the type.

BranchID.description: Defaults to the organization's default branch.

AutoFixPaymentsMismatchItems.description: Auto-fix ±0.01 rounding gaps between payments and items.

PrintOriginalPDFLink.description: Direct link to view/print the original PDF: {baseViewUrl}/Views/PDF.aspx?cipher={CipherTextOriginal}. Base view URL is https://newview.invoice4u.co.il on production, https://newviewqa.invoice4u.co.il on QA. Populated only by document creation (CreateDocument/CreateDocumentWithIdentifierValidation/CreateDocumentREST); null on every other endpoint — build the URL yourself from CipherTextOriginal there. No separate Base64/raw-PDF-bytes field exists.

PrintCertifiedCopyPDFLink.description: Direct link to view/print a certified copy: {baseViewUrl}/Views/PDF.aspx?cipher={CipherText}. Same base view URL as PrintOriginalPDFLink. Populated only by document creation (CreateDocument/CreateDocumentWithIdentifierValidation/CreateDocumentREST); null on every other endpoint — build the URL yourself from CipherText there.

CipherText.description: Encrypted token identifying this document; used as the cipher query param in PrintCertifiedCopyPDFLink. Always present on every endpoint that returns a Document.

CipherTextOriginal.description: Encrypted token identifying this document as the original; used as the cipher query param in PrintOriginalPDFLink. Always present on every endpoint that returns a Document.

ID.description: 0/omitted on create; required on update. Negative values are conflict codes: -1 name, -2 external number, -3 unique ID, -4 GUID.

ExtNumber.description: Your external customer number. Unique per organization.

PayTerms.description: Payment terms in days (0 = due now, 30 = EOM+30, ...).

Retainer.description: Whether the customer is on retainer.

Guid.description: Your external GUID. Unique per organization.

Discount.description: Default discount, resolved from the customer's assigned pricelist. Returned only by GetFullCustomer/GetCustomerById.

DiscountType.description: Discount type, resolved from the customer's assigned pricelist. Returned only by GetFullCustomer/GetCustomerById.

PricelistID.description: Assigned pricelist ID. Returned only by GetFullCustomer/GetCustomerById.

BankCode.description: Accepted but not currently linked to stored data — always returned empty.

BranchCode.description: Accepted but not currently linked to stored data — always returned empty.

PrintInternalNoteOnQuote.description: Whether InternalNote is printed on quotes.

OrgID.description: Organization the customer belongs to. Always set from your token.

IdNewAndOldSystem.description: Internal identifier bridging legacy and current systems.

HasBeenExported.description: Whether the customer was flagged as exported to accounting. Set by export processing, not by CreateCustomer/UpdateCustomer; also usable as a GetCustomers filter.

FreeUniqueID.description: Free-text identifier field. Also usable as a GetCustomers filter.

Ucan2ClientID.description: Internal link to the legacy Ucan2 system, if any.

CreditCardNumber.description: Stored card details (masked) used for retainer/standing-order billing.

NameAccounting.description: Contact name used for external accounting export.

EmailAccounting.description: Contact email used for external accounting export.

PhoneAccounting.description: Contact phone used for external accounting export.

IsFromLead.description: Whether the customer originated from a CRM lead.

HasToken.description: Whether a saved payment token exists for the customer — the token value itself is never returned.

PaymentDetailsIsDefault.description: Whether the stored payment details are the default for the customer. Returned only by GetFullCustomer/GetCustomerById.

IsUniqueIdValid.description: Not currently populated by any endpoint — always returned empty/default.

IsAutomaicInvoices.description: Not currently populated by any endpoint — always returned empty/default.

AddToMailChimp.description: Not currently populated by any endpoint — always returned empty/default.

Token.description: Not currently populated by any endpoint — always returned empty/default. See HasToken.

BankNameEnglish.description: Not currently populated by any endpoint — always returned empty/default.

BranchNameEnglish.description: Not currently populated by any endpoint — always returned empty/default.

FreeBalance.description: Not currently populated by any endpoint — always returned empty/default (0).

New.description: Internal flag; not meaningful for integrations.

Ucan2ID.description: Internal link to the legacy Ucan2 system; not meaningful for integrations.

DocumentType.description: Single document type filter — required by GetDocuments (one call searches one type).

DocumentTypes.description: Comma-separated list of types. Not honored by GetDocuments, GetCustomerReport or GetDraftDocuments — reserved for other internal report queries that share this schema.

FromPaymentDueDate.description: Not honored by GetDocuments — accepted by the shared schema but not forwarded to the search.

ToPaymentDueDate.description: Not honored by GetDocuments — accepted by the shared schema but not forwarded to the search.

CustomerName.description: For GetDocuments, only verifies that a customer with this name exists (ClientDoesntExists, 7, otherwise) — it does not filter new-system results. Use CustomerID to filter by customer.

FromNumber.description: Not honored by GetDocuments — use DocumentNumber/ExectDocumentNumber instead.

ToNumber.description: Not honored by GetDocuments — use DocumentNumber/ExectDocumentNumber instead.

ItemsIncluded.description: Not honored by GetDocuments — has no effect on whether Items come back in the results.

PaymentsIncluded.description: Not honored by GetDocuments — has no effect on whether Payments come back in the results.

Invoice4UUserApiKey.description: Your organization API key — the only supported authentication for clearing. Malformed GUID = ApiKeyNotInCorrectFormat (303); unknown key = UnauthorizedUser (80).

CreditCardCompanyType.description: Optional card-company code copied onto the internal charge record when greater than 0. It does not select the clearing provider — the provider used is your organization's configured clearing account (Cardcom, UPay or Meshulam). Leave unset unless directed otherwise by Invoice4U support.

Currency.description: NIS (default; ILS accepted as an alias), USD, EUR.

Type.description: 1 Regular (default), 2 Payments (installments), 3 CreditPayments. 4 is internal and provider-specific — do not send it. To refund, use Refund: true with PaymentId.

OrderIdClientUsage.description: Your order reference, echoed in callbacks. Not used to locate the original charge for refunds — use PaymentId.

Platform.description: Free-text identifier of the originating platform/system.

CustomerId.description: Existing customer ID. Required when ChargeWithToken is true — every provider integration dereferences it to look up the stored token, and omitting it fails without a clean API error.

IsAutoCreateCustomer.description: Finds an existing customer by phone; if no match is found, creates a new customer record from FullName/Phone/Email. Matching by email alone is not currently supported.

IsGeneralClient.description: Issue the document to a general customer. Default true.

IsDocCreate.description: Create a document after a successful charge.

IsManualDocCreationsWithParams.description: Provide explicit items via pipe-separated DocItem* fields.

DocItemName.description: Pipe-separated item names, e.g. "Item A|Item B".

DocItemCode.description: Accepted but not applied to the created document in the current implementation — do not rely on it.

IsItemsBase64Encoded.description: Not supported — decoding is incomplete in the current implementation. Send DocItem* values as plain UTF-8 text, not Base64.

DocBranchId.description: Accepted but not applied to the created document in the current implementation — do not rely on it for branch assignment.

AddToken.description: Save a card token without charging.

AddTokenAndCharge.description: Save a token and charge Sum.

ChargeWithToken.description: Charge the customer's stored token (server-to-server). Requires CustomerId — omitting it fails without a clean API error.

PaymentId.description: Provider payment reference. Populated in the response for hosted-page charges; required in the request for every refund (Refund: true) to look up the original charge (PaymentIDDoesntExists 60 when not found).

IsStandingOrderClearance.description: Set up a recurring monthly charge.

StandingOrderDuration.description: Number of monthly charges. Required for standing orders.

ClearingRedirectUrl.description: Hosted payment page URL — redirect the customer here.

OrganizationId.description: Your organization's ID; used internally for the ownership check on GetClearingLogById.

CustomerUniqueId.description: Payer identity/ID number captured at the hosted page — same value as UniqueId in the callback payload.

CurrencyName.description: Text name of Currency, e.g. NIS.

CreditType.description: Your organization's credit-card company ID, as configured on your account — not a fixed system-wide code.

ClearingCompany.description: ClearingCompanies enum: 6 UPay, 7 Meshulam, 12 YaadSarig (historical records only), 15 Cardcom.

PaymentId.description: Provider payment reference — use for refunds.

TransactionType.description: 0 Charge, 1 TokenCreation, 2 TokenAndCharge, 3 ChargeByToken, 4 PaymentInNumbers, 5 PaymentWithFees, 6 Credit, 7 MobileAppPersonalPayment, 8 TokenPaymentInNumbers.

CreateDocumentType.description: Internal document-type code recorded when a document was auto-created for the charge (0 when none was created).

ClearingLogBaseId.description: Internal. Links a response-type row (LogType 2) back to the request-type row (LogType 1) it belongs to.

TransactionId.description: Internal. Provider-specific transaction identifier; not required for integration.

TransactionToken.description: Internal. Provider-specific transaction token; not required for integration.

UpdateRequestLog.description: Internal. Used only when inserting a log via ProcessApiRequestClearingLogInsertREST_V2; not meaningful when reading existing logs.

OrganizationUniqueId.description: Business VAT/company number. Must be unique.

BundleID.description: Ignored by the server. The new organization's bundle is always server-assigned — bundle 23 (a default trial bundle) by default; some partner integrations map to a different bundle.

ApiKey.description: Pre-provisioned API key for the new account.

Code.description: Item code (SKU). Empty string when not set.

IsNonStockItem.description: Inventory-related; ignore without the Inventory module.

TotalQuantityInStock.description: Inventory-related; ignore without the Inventory module.

TotalQuantity.description: Inventory-related; ignore without the Inventory module.

SerialNumber.description: Inventory-related; ignore without the Inventory module.

BatchNumber.description: Inventory-related; ignore without the Inventory module.

QuantityToNotify.description: Low-stock alert threshold. GetTopSoldItems / GetHighestByValue reuse this field for the reported total quantity or value.

OrganizationID.description: Set by the server from the token.

DiscountType.description: 0 = Discount is a percentage, 1 = Discount is a fixed amount in the organization currency.

LinkedCustomers.description: Comma-separated customer IDs linked to the price list (e.g. "88231"). Sent on create/update and echoed back by the server.

IsActive.description: Send true for an active price list — omitted means false.

WcfDate.description: WCF JSON date: /Date(<milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC><±hhmm>)/. Also accepted with escaped slashes (\/Date(...)\/). ISO-8601 strings are NOT accepted.

TaxRate.description: VAT percentage (e.g. 18). 17 for dates before 2025-01-01, otherwise the system-wide standard rate from the TaxRate app setting (same value for every organization, not the organization's own VAT setting). -1 when the token is invalid or the account has expired (the ExpiredAccount (66) error from IsAuthenticated is not carried over — only UnauthorizedUser (80) is set).

allOf.description: Document numbering definition of the organization. Other serialized members (ID, Deposit, *Current, *DocMin, IsAdvancedSearchDocumentReferences, OrganizationID) are not populated by DocumentsNumberingGet.

InvoiceCreated.description: true once a document of this type exists (the starting number can no longer change). Same for the other *Created flags.

Register.description: Accounting ledger (card) number used for accounting export. Same for the other Register*/TaxCredit/Income/ExemptIncome/Deal/GeneralCustomer/Lawyer* members.

LawyerExpenses.description: 0 when not set — declared as long? on the model, but the mapper turns a DB NULL into 0, so this endpoint never actually returns null here. Only meaningful for law-firm-mode organizations.

LawyerDeposit.description: 0 when not set, same as LawyerExpenses.

BankDetails.description: Bank details printed on documents (AccountNumber, BankName, BranchName, AccountOwner, BIC).

EnglishBankDetails.description: English bank details printed on documents (ABA, AccountNumberEnglish, ...).

IsBankDetails.description: Whether the organization has filled in Hebrew bank details.

IsEnglishBankDetails.description: Whether the organization has filled in English bank details.

allOf.description: Organization projection returned by UserIsraelInvoicesStatus. The JSON also contains every other Organization member with default values (0/false/null) — ignore them.

IsraelInvoicesConnected.description: true when the organization is connected to Israel Invoices (allocation numbers).

ItemsBalance.description: Movement rows (Date, Qty, Entry, Exit, Op).
